name: Adarsh Plant Protect Limited
about: Adarsh Plant Protect Limited designs, manufactures, and sells agricultural products in India. The company operates through three segments: Industrial Packaging, Agriculture and Plant Protection, and Smokeless Chulha and Ecostove. It offers agriculture powered battery and manual sprayer pumps; agriculture equipment and tools, including duster, spreader, broadcaster and seed dressing drums; and single family and community smokeless chulha cooking stoves. The company also provides plastic and HDPE drums; metal and steel barrels comprising all side welded, composite, epoxy, GP sheet, MS plain, NRV, open top, and zinc electroplated barrels; vertical tanks, LPG tanks, filter tanks, buffer tanks, tanks for drinking water, and container and fuel stations; and transformer tanks, such as plain steel sheet, tube, corrugated wall type transformer, transformer oil, radiatorpanel type, and tubular cooling type tanks, as well as tanks with separate coolers. In addition, it offers core and support frames, assembling components, yoke clamps, etc. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Anand, India.
